objective.name: sandbox.reflect.local.meaning
objective.description: Wrapper-backed capacity that reads local meaning through Reflexive and returns a normalized summary.

#root.role: Ask the local Reflexive family for one capacity meaning descriptor and summarize objective and functional sections.

effects.local_reflexive_route: The wrapper performs one local outbound read.meaning request.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local wrapper request becomes a normalized meaning summary after one outbound local Reflexive read.
invariants: The wrapper always performs exactly one local outbound read.meaning request for a capacity element.
The first result row is normalized from either desc or descriptor depending on the returned payload shape.
Absent name defaults to sandbox.echo before the outbound call is issued.
success: On success, sandbox.reflect.local.meaning returns summary fields extracted from the first result row plus the raw_item, ctx_id, and wrapper_name.
item_ok mirrors the first read.meaning row rather than indicating outbound transport status by itself.
failure: The capability fails if the outbound local Reflexive call cannot complete.
Descriptor extraction can degrade to empty strings without turning the call into a contract failure when the first row is simply missing sections.
notes: This capability is used as a wrapper-side oracle for detailed local meaning reads in N7.
The raw_item output intentionally exposes the first reflected row for test diagnostics.
